1 Scope, access and delivery

1.  Covered assets. The supplier shall monitor the listed sensors, inspect alert histories and issue one
    monthly service record for each site. Physical replacement of plant is excluded unless separately
    authorised under clause 8.

2.  Access readiness. The client shall provide a named escort and safe access during the agreed service
   window. An unsuccessful visit caused by denied access is rescheduled once without a second call-out
    charge; the original response clock is paused only for the documented access delay.

3.  Priority assessment. Priority is determined by operational impact, not by the number of alerts. A fire-
   system interface alert is escalated immediately to the client duty officer; this agreement does not replace
   emergency services.

4.  Completion evidence. A job is complete only when the service record identifies the asset, arrival time,
    action taken and verification reading. A photograph without an asset reference is insufficient.

Definitions


Term                                           Meaning

Acknowledgement                            A human response confirming ownership of the incident.

Attendance                                 A qualified operative reaches the nominated site reception.

Restoration                                      The asset is returned to service or a client-approved safe
                                                    workaround is active.

Business day                                          Monday-Friday, excluding the public holidays stated in

Service record                                One auditable record per job, including any linked follow-
                                                 up visit.



An acknowledgement is not attendance. Meeting an acknowledgement target does not stop the attendance
clock. Schedule B defines the separate targets.

Boundary example

window.
